build.title: AmberX Design Package + Behaviour theme: Fable rebuild

said.text: Fable rebuild of the Opus build on rebuild/design-package-opus (Fable suggested, Opus chosen). Starts by reading _claude/memory/docs/rebuilds/design-package.md and replacing the Opus build in place: same type names (design-package, behavior-theme), data format and setting keys unless the report says why. Wire the stored-only behaviour fields (windows.stack/minimize/snap, feedback.busyCursor) into the window manager, review the Settings → Appearance picker + Everything else container, screenshots before/after, differences report.

steps.text: Read the Opus report + code; list what to keep, change, wire in
Review design-package engine + runtime apply/capture/migration; fix gaps
Review behaviour engine + CSS; refine motion/interaction mappings
Wire windows.stack / minimize / snap + snapGrid into the window manager
Wire feedback.busyCursor + confirmDelete into framework controls
Settings → Appearance picker + Everything else container polish
Extend check-design-package.mts; regenerate fixtures; re-bake apps
Before/after screenshots, differences report, LOG line, PR
